batch_recovery_fix.problem: A RENDER step fans out into ONE engine job per scene/shot unit; the durable checkpoint previously reconciled only the primary external_id (first job) and ingestion completed the step after the FIRST result.
fix: checkpoint.PendingExternalOperation.job_ids carries EVERY engine job of the batch (step_executor.py); from_dict promotes legacy external_id

recovery.decide_batch(pending) aggregates per-job decisions fail-closed: ANY unknown -> RECONCILE_UNKNOWN (never resubmit); ANY failed -> NEW_ATTEMPT (bounded); ANY generating -> REATTACH; ALL completed -> RESUME (recovery.py)
engine.recover() uses decide_batch when the pending op carries a multi-job batch (engine.py)
engine.ingest_external_result() only clears the pending op and completes the step when EVERY batch job has been ingested (tracked via run.output_hashes)
ProductionEngineExecutor.cancel_batch(job_ids) cancels EVERY job of the batch, persisting terminal receipts
